chunks: In order that He may recompense those who have believed and done the right. For them will be forgiveness and worthy sustenance.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for those who believe and do righteous deeds according to Surah Saba?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Saba, this verse highlights the ultimate objective of prophetic mission: to distinguish and reward those who combine faith with righteous action. Shia scholarship often interprets 'rizq karim' (generous provision) not merely as material sustenance but as the spiritual nourishment and eternal bliss of Paradise, reflecting the divine justice that pairs belief with deed. This promise serves as a counterpoint to the fate of the disbelievers mentioned in the preceding verses, emphasizing that true success lies in divine forgiveness and elevated spiritual status.
